# Sullivan-Mór Frontend Rules

## Core Principles
- **Simplicity First:** Always provide the most basic and lean solution possible. Avoid over-engineering.
- **Code Style:** Keep it short, readable, and follow traditional Angular best practices.
- **Minimalism:** No "Code Smells". If a task is complex, break it down or use a well-known library instead of custom boilerplate.

## Angular & Logic
- **Standard Patterns:** Use standard Angular signals/services/components (v20+ style if applicable).
- **Libraries:** If a library (like Reactive Forms or a UI kit) simplifies the code, use it or ask to include it instead of manual implementations.
